protocol: Sol Ordem 256: same content and sales-closed state; primary CTA visible and clickable without obstruction; no overlap with the sticky buy bar; light and dark; widths 360 plus official 390, 1024, 1280, 1366, 1536; before/after vs base; no regression on shared pages.
method: scripts/audit/sales-local-server.mjs (real sales Worker, same CSP/routing) serving each build; Playwright chromium-1194, deviceScaleFactor 1, prefers-color-scheme light/dark; viewport screenshot (above the fold); CTA = .hero .button.primary; sticky bar = .buy-bar when visible; hit test = elementFromPoint at the CTA centre returns the CTA. PNGs quantized to 128 colours.

states.regressed: PR #927 fc1a28d9c8adc3f223dfb6c889aeda2d1669fcec (8-9 line hero, CTA under the buy bar at 360)
states.after: PR #927 working tree committed with this manifest

pass_rule: cta_fully_in_viewport and not cta_overlaps_sticky_bar and not cta_under_header and cta_hit_test_ok and sales_closed and not horizontal_overflow (solucoes has no hero CTA: sales_closed and no horizontal overflow)
